SCM optical transmission systems are affected by a number of distortion phenomena which can be classified into two categories: intrinsic distortions, due to the interaction between photons and electrons in semiconductor devices, and extrinsic distortions, due mainly to the interaction between optical and electrical signals in the transmission channel.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SCM systems with semiconductor lasers and external intensity modulators have different performance characteristics.
the SCM optical transmission system can be considered as an optical wireless system, where the optical channel is the optical fiber and the wireless channel is the SCM channel.
the use of a semiconductor laser in SCM systems is preferable with respect to external modulators.
